description: This file defines a UI component named 'Button' using the LightningJS framework. It specifies a template with dynamic content based on component state, manages state, and handles an input event to toggle a favorited state.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a toggleable button with favoriting functionality.
